warnings: Exact customer-specific HDO export is not auto-refreshed because the ČEZ DIP endpoint is CAPTCHA-protected; the current verified export is combined with a daily public-source change monitor.
D45d requires HDO blocking of electric heating, but the actual boiler wiring has not been physically verified.
The 1.0 °C EMOS DIFF setting is used as the working setting but is not machine-read from the thermostat.

checks.name: passive_window_indoor_coverage_guard
checks.detail: Passive fitting must reject sparse indoor windows, gaps over 60 minutes, and windows whose endpoint thermostat setpoint is unknown.

checks.name: forecast_gap_fail_closed
checks.detail: Passive forecast must fail closed across weather gaps larger than the documented maximum step.

checks.name: thermal_data_coverage_contract
checks.detail: Thermal model inputs must expose machine-readable observed/expected counts, coverage and largest gap.

checks.name: forecast_model_coverage_guard
checks.detail: Every published passive forecast horizon must have sufficient model-branch coverage; a single model branch is not enough.

checks.name: post_heating_quarantine_guard
checks.detail: Passive fitting must infer heating end from plateau-to-cooling evidence before the 12 h quarantine, fail conservatively while confirmation is incomplete, and keep source attribution explicitly unproven.

checks.name: current_indoor_freshness_and_connectivity
checks.detail: Current indoor state must be freshness-gated to at most 30 minutes, and an explicitly offline EMOS device must never be considered live.

checks.name: current_state_freshness_and_provenance
checks.detail: Current passive-rate estimate requires both a fresh connected indoor observation and a freshness-gated DWD/ČHMÚ outdoor observation.

checks.name: dp2_not_used_as_boiler_proof
checks.detail: DP2 must not be used as proof of actual boiler/relay heating state.

checks.name: heating_control_not_overclaimed
checks.detail: Thermal model is marked validated for heating control before both passive prediction and absolute energy scale are calibrated.

checks.name: passive_fit_positive
checks.detail: Passive thermal fit is missing or non-physical.

checks.name: passive_fit_internal_consistency
checks.detail: Production coupling must remain inside its empirical p25-p75 support and tau must be consistent with 1/coupling.

checks.name: oracle_negative_controls
checks.detail: One or more known-bad data-quality controls passed as normal data; fix the checker/gate before trusting PASS results.

checks.name: shadow_estimator_isolation
checks.detail: Alternative passive estimators must remain shadow-only and must not silently alter the production forecast.

checks.name: energy_scale_not_overclaimed
checks.detail: Absolute kWh scale must remain explicitly uncalibrated until active-heating evidence exists.

checks.name: energy_model_current_price
checks.detail: Thermal model is using a stale electricity price.

checks.name: reference_energy_math
checks.detail: Reference kWh/cost table does not match H × degree-hours / efficiency × current price.
